id: title:jonmcwest:make the inspector row renderers exhaustive over item types

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the TypeScript typing and rendering implementation of the session recording inspector, not the recording or ingestion of events.
review.reason: Replaced inline switch statements with a dedicated helper function and an explicit TypeScript interface, while retaining the same conditional rendering and null-return cases.
review.uncertainty: This is a frontend-only change; while it improves code maintainability and typing, it does not demonstrate a broader systemic benefit, performance improvement, or critical reliability enhancement. The tier is assigned based on the localized refactoring, not on unverified production outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file, frontend-only change. No score assigned.
